messages:
maya: Quick note: before the pin migration we should finalize a compact lease surface for client+router checks. I sketched something small that avoids full manifest fetches.

devin: paste the sketch pls.

maya: Sketch: stable fields: pin_id, lease (opaque string with ns/shard/epoch), lease_kind (sparse|explicit), epoch, fence flag, probation window, provenance, compat_hint. Example pseudo: ```rollout_meta:
pin_id: "tenant/alpha#anchor"
lease: "sparse:ns=alpha;shard=2;epoch=20260401T12"
lease_kind: "sparse"
epoch: 42
fence: true   # treat missing lease as invalid
probation: {duration_ms:300000, allow_reads:true}
provenance: "git:abcd1234"
compat_hint: "v1-client-only-ignore-fence-until=2026-05-01"
```

sam: If fence=true and client doesn't see lease, fallback immediately? That could spike fallbacks during brief GC windows.

lina: Suggestion: clients treat fence as conditional: only enforce if epoch >= last_seen_epoch + 1 OR probation is absent/expired. Probation softens during migrations.

arjun: Backcompat: older clients ignore new fields. We need control-plane to set compat_hint and run a grace window so old clients don't silently keep stale anchors.

devin: For routers, encode shard+epoch into lease string so local cache probes are cheap. If cache miss -> control plane lookup. Avoid fetch-on-every-request.

maya: TTL / caching rules: when lease present use min(lease_ttl, client_max_ttl). When lease absent use exponential backoff with jitter and record fallback_reason telemetry (fence-missing).

sam: Also decide epoch bit width; recommend 64-bit monotonic counter from control plane. If we document wrap semantics it's fine to pick 64 to be future-proof.

lina: Probation detail: control-plane sets probation.start_ts + duration_ms. Clients that have last_seen_ts within probation and allow_reads=true keep using anchor, but log probation_read events. Once probation expired, enforce fence normally.

arjun: Ops checklist: expose telemetry keys: fallback_reason, last_seen_epoch, probation_used, lease_kind. These are critical to debug noisy rollouts.

maya: Next steps: I will author an RFC draft with the minimal schema and example client pseudocode for epoch/probation checks. Lina/devin/sam: please review.

deploy-bot: deploy:control-plane v2.14 -> canary started (sha abcd1234). rollout_meta.telemetry=on

devin: Also document mapping from fallback -> routing policy (prefer stable variant with longer TTL and lower throughput).

maya: thanks everyone. I'll post RFC link when drafted. :thumbsup:
